shared_elements: upright freestanding stone monument with carved figural imagery
anthropomorphic figure carved in relief on a slab/block
suggestion of a head/upper body atop a broad body
justification: Both depict a single frontal anthropomorphic figure occupying a tall upright block, with a head above a broad torso, but A shows a naturalistic nude body with modelled breasts, waist and legs emerging from a pillar, while B shows a heavily schematic, almost geometric figure whose 'body' is a field of shallow curvilinear and circular motifs (discs, arcs, bands) with no rendered limbs. The correspondence is limited to the generic idea of a standing frontal figure on a monolith, with no shared specific motifs or relationships.
